partner_result.use: The d=0 specialization of the floor-enhanced two-by-two Gram bound reproduces r48 exactly; at a=b=2,c=0, later local matrix actions 1/32 and 1/64 give s6>=125/64.

pinned_source.completed_result_used: D5 fifth-volume density theorem: ||p_Q||inf <= 5 sqrt(2e) e5(M^T M)^(-1/10) for an actual original-coordinate cross block, with no row-marginal condition.

theorem_summary: For the partner orthogonal-output carrier M=[F;W], split by the low right-singular subspace K of F and retain d=inf_K||Fy||, a=inf_Kperp||Fz||, b=inf_K||Wy||, c=||W P_Kperp||. Then s_m(M)^2 is at least the minimum eigenvalue of [[d^2+b^2,-bc],[-bc,a^2+c^2]]. This bound is at least d^2, so unbounded transverse leakage cannot destroy a positive low-singular floor. A later dense coefficient tail of operator norm delta costs only delta by Weyl.
exact_target_application: A six-by-five original-coordinate cross family with F=diag(1/2,2,2,2,2) and hostile row W=(2,-c,0,0,0), arbitrary c, has s5>=1/2 uniformly. Any dense symmetric tail of norm <=1/64 leaves s5>=31/64; D5 gives ||p_Q||inf <= 320 sqrt(2e)/31 = 24.068583035841282... . Three untouched coefficient-2 hyperbolic pairs imply s6(A)>=127/64>1 after the same tail. Arbitrary symmetric spectator spectrum is allowed.
dense_tail_guard: Only coefficient-matrix compression and singular-value Weyl are used; no claim that X^T T X is uniformly small on unbounded inputs.
